description:
VERSION NOTE: Ploughs and Farming Machines were previously Land and Building. Now they are Land and Invention.
VERSION NOTE: The Royal Storehouse now has Stays in play and only makes 1 card stay in play each turn.
This is a card made accessible by the Engineer. To discover it, you must first discard him and destroy a Food Barns in play. The red arrows at the top of this card means that when you discover it, you must choose which of its 2 sides should be face up (the serial number must be at the top of this card, whichever side you choose). Choose wisely, since you cannot change this later. Ploughs may be upgraded into Farming Machines, a card that is counted as both a land and a building, which stays in play with its awesome production. Larger Barns, and later the Royal Storehouse, allows you to store your cards for later use (it can even make itself stay in play together with your favorite card). They're both really good!
